meta.name: Prototype Severity Policy
meta.important_notice: This severity mapping is an implementation policy for the prototype. It is NOT part of the original candidate assignment rules.

overrides.when: A-07 contains direct denigration of a named competitor or broad unsupported superiority claim with strong wording
A-01 absolute claim is central/headline-level and strongly categorical (e.g. unique/100%/No.1) with no support

uncertainty_policy.rule: UNCERTAIN is an evidence state, not a risk severity.
uncertainty_policy.behavior: When the system lacks sufficient evidence, set rule status to UNCERTAIN and do not invent HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW.
uncertainty_policy.overall: If there is no confirmed RISK but at least one material UNCERTAIN item, overall_status must be UNCERTAIN.

human_review.A-09: when authenticity or authorization cannot be verified
human_review.A-10: request better evidence or human review
human_review.validator_failure: always after the single retry also fails
